items.title: Applied AI Engineer, Digital Natives
items.description: About the Team OpenAI’s Applied AI Engineering team helps organizations turn frontier AI capabilities into safe, reliable, and high-impact production systems. We work with customer executives, product and engineering teams, security leaders, and transformation teams to identify valuable opportunities, accelerate technical implementation, and scale what works. Enterprise deployments are defined by complexity rather than any one industry: existing architectures, diverse data environments, security and governance requirements, multiple stakeholder groups, and organization-wide change. We turn lessons from these deployments into better products and reusable patterns for customers everywhere. About the Role As an Applied AI Engineer, you will partner directly with Digital Native companies to design, build and deploy AI-powered products and systems. Working alongside customer product and engineering teams, you will take ideas from early experimentation through evaluation, production launch and scale, connecting technical decisions to user experience and measurable business impact. You will write and debug code, build evaluation systems, resolve complex integrations, and guide decisions involving model behavior, reliability, latency, cost, safety, security, governance, and operational readiness. Success is measured by production systems, sustained adoption, and meaningful customer impact—not simply activity or successful demonstrations. This is a rare opportunity to work on consequential real-world deployments at the frontier of AI while directly influencing how OpenAI’s products evolve. This role is based in London. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees In this role, you will: - Partner directly with Digital Native customers to identify high-value opportunities and translate them into technical architectures, implementation plans, evaluation strategies, and measurable success criteria. - Design, build, and deploy AI systems that solve important customer problems and produce measurable business outcomes. - Work hands-on in code to build prototypes, evaluation harnesses, reference implementations, integrations, and production accelerators. - Make sound technical decisions across models, agents, retrieval, tools, data, reliability, observability, latency, cost, safety, security, and governance. - Diagnose complex implementation challenges, reproduce failures, test hypotheses, and drive blockers toward resolution. - Help customers progress from promising prototypes to reliable production systems, sustained adoption, and scaled impact. - Partner closely with customer engineering teams and OpenAI Product, Research, Engineering, Security, and go-to-market teams, translating deployment experience into high-signal product feedback. - Create reusable architectures, tooling, playbooks, and technical guidance that accelerate future enterprise deployments. You’ll thrive in this role if you: - Have a demonstrated track record of designing, building, and delivering AI or machine-learning systems in enterprise environments, including taking systems from prototype to production. Relevant backgrounds may include applied AI or ML engineering, forward-deployed engineering, software engineering, customer engineering, solutions architecture, or technical consulting. - Can point to substantial personal contributions in code, architecture, evaluation, debugging, or production engineering—not only program or stakeholder management. - Are highly proficient in Python and comfortable working across an AI application stack; experience with JavaScript, TypeScript, or another relevant language is valuable. - Understand how to evaluate AI systems systematically using representative data, graders, production signals, and human judgment. - Have navigated enterprise production requirements such as integrations, reliability, observability, security, privacy, data governance, performance, and cost. - Can connect technical decisions to customer workflows, adoption, and measurable business outcomes. - Communicate with clarity and credibility across hands-on engineers, technical leaders, security teams, product leaders, and executives. - Bring high agency, strong technical judgment, and end-to-end ownership in ambiguous environments. - Learn quickly, challenge assumptions constructively, and collaborate with humility; experience in a particular industry or with OpenAI products is not required. About OpenAI OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity. We are an equal opportunity employer, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. items.title: Office & Facilities Manager
items.description: Our global HQ in Malta is looking for an Office & Facilities Manager who loves turning workplaces into places people genuinely enjoy coming to. If you’re proactive, detail-driven, and energised by creating great day-to-day experiences, this is your opportunity to shape how our offices in Malta look, feel, and run. The Wow As the Office & Facilities Manager , you’ll own the smooth running of our Malta workplace operations and help set the standard for how our spaces support people. From facilities excellence to a standout employee experience, you’ll make sure every detail enables productivity, wellbeing, and our Betsson brand. You’ll also bring our culture to life by delivering well-run internal events and office initiatives. Reporting to the Director of HR Support in Malta, you will implement workplace standards, manage budgets and supplier partnerships, and ensure our offices are safe, efficient, and welcoming. You’ll coordinate everything from day-to-day services to event logistics, so employees and visitors experience a seamless, on-brand workplace. What you’ll be involved in: Key responsibilities (including, but not limited to): Deliver engaging internal events and office initiatives (e.g., Friday Get-Togethers, on-site parties, and activities), covering logistics, run-of-show, supplier coordination, comms, budgets, and post-event learnings. Own office and facility operations, ensuring safety, functionality, and a consistently great look-and-feel aligned with Betsson’s brand. Maintain facility management processes and documentation that support ESG/ISO standards and focus on continuous improvement. Manage vendor and supplier relationships (facilities and event-related), ensuring strong service, clear SLAs, and cost-effective solutions. Support space planning and expansion projects, coordinating moves, changes, and office improvements to match business growth. Manage health, safety, and compliance protocols across the office, including risk assessments and safe working practices for on-site activities and events. Monitor and manage budgets for facilities and workplace experience spend, tracking costs and optimising for value without compromising quality. Lead and develop the reception team to deliver a warm, professional front-of-house experience for employees and visitors. What we are looking for: 5+ years of experience in facilities management, office operations, workplace experience, or a similar role within a global organisation. Hands-on experience planning and executing office events (from supplier sourcing and budgets to on-the-day coordination and wrap-up). Proven expertise managing multi-site operations, budget oversight, and vendor partnerships, with a pragmatic, service-minded approach. Knowledge of health, safety, and environmental regulations, plus solid technical facilities management understanding. Excellent project management and communication skills, with the ability to coordinate stakeholders across teams and locations (including event partners). Why join us? Be part of a vibrant, fast-paced industry at the heart of Malta’s online gaming scene. Join a collaborative, people-focused HR team that values ownership, smart solutions, and getting things done. Grow your career in an environment that encourages autonomy, continuous learning, and development. Much like a rollercoaster, life at Betsson Group is fast-paced, full of twists and turns, and always exciting. With more than 2,800 colleagues representing over 75 nationalities across a global network of offices – including 1,500 at our operational headquarters in Malta – every day brings new challenges and opportunities to grow. It may not be for the faint-hearted, but if you thrive on innovation, enjoy pushing boundaries and want to be part of a diverse, international team, then you’ll fit right in at Betsson. Challenge Accepted? By submitting your application, you understand that your personal data will be processed as set out in our Privacy Policy .

items.description: ABOUT THE TEAM OpenAI Finance is responsible for ensuring the organization is set up for success in pursuit of its mission to ensure that artificial general intelligence benefits all of humanity. The Controllership team delivers the financial truth that powers OpenAI’s growth. By translating operational activity into accurate, timely, and decision-grade financial data, we enable leadership to scale the business with confidence. Our commitment to rigorous controls and best-in-class systems ensures financial integrity as OpenAI grows. ABOUT THE ROLE We are seeking a strategic and execution-oriented Accounting Lead, Hardware to build and scale inventory accounting capabilities across consumer hardware and robotics businesses. This role partners closely with Finance, Supply Chain, Manufacturing Operations, Technical Accounting, Strategic Finance, and Systems teams to establish scalable inventory and supply chain accounting processes and reporting infrastructure supporting rapid growth and product launches. The ideal candidate brings strong accounting fundamentals, sound judgment, and a track record of building scalable processes in complex, evolving businesses. Inventory, cost accounting, or supply chain experience is preferred, and accounting experience supporting hardware, infrastructure, data centers, or other capital-intensive operations is also valuable. We welcome strong accounting professionals from other backgrounds who have demonstrated the ability to quickly learn unfamiliar business models and accounting topics and take ownership of new areas. This person should thrive in ambiguity, combine strategic thinking with hands-on execution, and communicate effectively with cross-functional partners and senior leadership. This role is based in San Francisco, CA. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees. IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL: INVENTORY ACCOUNTING - Lead inventory and supply chain accounting across consumer hardware and robotics programs, including inventory valuation, supply chain/sourcing arrangements, manufacturing variances, reserves, and close processes. - Partner with Supply Chain, Operations, and Strategic Finance to support BOM accuracy, labor and overhead assumptions, operationalize supply chain strategies and gross margin analysis. - Develop scalable accounting processes for NPI, prototyping, engineering builds, and mass production. - Own inventory-related accounting policies and controls, including capitalization, overhead allocation, LCNRV/NRV assessments, rebates, freight, tariffs, and inventory controls. ERP SYSTEMS & PROCESS DESIGN - Serve as a finance lead for Oracle Fusion manufacturing costing and inventory implementations, enhancements, and process optimization. - Partner with Systems, IT, and Operations to design scalable finance processes, controls, reporting structures, and operational workflows. - Partner with Systems and Operations to define accounting requirements and guide ERP design for product costing, inventory transactions, and related reporting and controls. FINANCIAL CLOSE, REPORTING & CONTROLS - Lead monthly, quarterly, and annual cost accounting close activities and improve scalable reconciliations, reporting, and management review processes. - Partner with Strategic Finance on margin reporting, inventory analytics, and budget versus actual analysis. - Establish SOX-ready controls, support audits and technical accounting matters, and drive continuous improvement across close and reporting processes. CROSS-FUNCTIONAL LEADERSHIP - Act as a strategic partner to Operations, Supply Chain, Procurement, and Program Management teams. - Translate ambiguous business needs into scalable accounting and operational frameworks. - Influence senior stakeholders through strong communication, executive presence, and data-driven recommendations. - Help build and scale the long-term roadmap for hardware controllership, manufacturing accounting, and operational finance infrastructure. YOU MIGHT THRIVE IN THIS ROLE IF YOU: - Bring strong accounting judgment and enjoy learning how physical products, infrastructure, and operational workflows translate into financial reporting. - Have a track record of quickly developing expertise in unfamiliar accounting areas, asking thoughtful questions, and turning what you learn into practical processes and controls. - Can comfortably operate between strategic leadership discussions and highly detailed operational accounting analyses. - Have strong executive presence and can communicate effectively with senior leadership and cross-functional partners. - Enjoy building scalable processes and infrastructure in fast-moving, ambiguous environments. - Are highly detail-oriented and maintain a strong control mindset while balancing business partnership. - Have a strong systems orientation and enjoy designing scalable ERP and reporting processes. - Are intellectually curious, proactive, and solutions-oriented. QUALIFICATIONS REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS - Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field. - 8+ years of progressive accounting experience, with ownership of complex accounting areas, close processes, or operational accounting. - Strong understanding of U.S. GAAP and demonstrated ability to research unfamiliar accounting topics and apply sound judgment. - Demonstrated ability to quickly learn new business models, systems, and operational processes and take ownership of unfamiliar accounting areas. - Experience building or improving accounting processes, reconciliations, controls, and reporting. - Strong systems aptitude and experience working with ERP systems and financial data. - Excellent analytical, communication, and cross-functional partnership skills. - Demonstrated ability to influence stakeholders and execute effectively in ambiguous, fast-moving environments. PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS Experience in one or more of the following areas is valuable; candidates are not expected to bring all of them: - Inventory, cost, manufacturing, or supply chain accounting, including inventory valuation, standard costing, manufacturing variances, overhead allocation, rebates and buy/sell etc. - Accounting supporting hardware, infrastructure, data centers, electronics, robotics, semiconductors, or other capital-intensive operations. - Work with contract manufacturers, global supply chains, hardware product launches, or manufacturing scale-up. - Oracle Fusion, particularly Costing and Inventory modules, or comparable ERP implementation and process improvement experience. - CPA and/or public accounting background. - Experience in a high-growth technology environment or building and leading accounting teams. items.title: Data Center Strategic Sourcing Lead - Construction
items.location_text: San Francisco, CA | New York City, NY
items.description: About Anthropic Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. About the role We are hiring a Construction Sourcing Manager to develop and execute procurement strategies for the materials, components, and parts needed to build Anthropic's data centers. In this role, you will own end-to-end sourcing for construction materials such as wire and cable, lugs and connectors, conduit and cable tray, breakers and fuses, grounding, pipe, valves, fittings, and structural supports. You will partner closely with engineering, construction, demand planning, general contractors, and trade contractors to make sure the right material is on site when crews need it, establish direct manufacturer and distributor relationships, and negotiate commercial agreements. This role complements our major equipment sourcing leads: they source the equipment, and you source what is needed to install, connect, and energize it. Key responsibilities Own sourcing for electrical construction materials: medium- and low-voltage cable, building wire, control and instrumentation cable, lugs, connectors, terminations and splice kits, conduit and fittings, cable tray, busway, breakers, fuses, panelboards, grounding, and enclosures. Own sourcing for mechanical and structural construction materials: pipe, valves, fittings, flanges, gaskets, hoses, insulation, sensors, strut, hangers, anchors, and fasteners. Negotiate Master Purchase Agreements, national pricing agreements, and blanket orders with manufacturers and distributors, including index-based pricing for copper, aluminum, and steel, capacity reservations, and volume rebates. Run competitive RFQs, build should-cost models and unit-price benchmarks, and audit contractor material pricing, markups, and procurement schedules. Decide with construction and design partners which materials to buy direct versus through contractors, and aggregate demand across sites to secure better price and supply. Implement frameworks for ensuring data center partners, general contractors, and trade contractors buy against our negotiated terms, approved manufacturer lists, and technical specifications. Work with engineering to standardize parts, qualify second sources, and approve alternates that meet code, listing (e.g., NEC, UL), and design requirements. Develop material inventory and logistics strategy including distributor stocking programs, buffer stock, cable cutting and reel management, kitting, staging, and just-in-time site delivery. Proactively monitor supply chain volatility (e.g., commodity prices, tariffs, and lead times for medium-voltage cable, breakers, and valves), expedite shortages, and execute contingency plans to avoid project delays. Translate drawings, bills of materials, quantity takeoffs, and construction schedules into material forecasts and procurement pipelines, and update them as designs change. Partner with Finance on material budgets, commodity exposure, inventory investment, and savings tracking. Establish efficient workflows for damaged, defective, short-shipped, and surplus material, including returns and redeployment across sites. Negotiate warranty, delivery, and spare parts terms, and track supplier performance on on-time delivery, fill rate, quality, and price. Minimum qualifications Have 7+ years experience in sourcing, procurement, or supply chain management, including direct experience buying electrical or mechanical construction materials. Have a track record of forecasting, sourcing, and delivering high-volume, multi-SKU construction materials against active project schedules. Have negotiated supply agreements with both manufacturers and electrical or mechanical distributors, and understand commodity-linked pricing. Are familiar with data center construction materials (e.g., MV/LV cable, lugs, terminations, conduit, cable tray, busway, breakers, grounding, pipe, valves, fittings, supports) and can read drawings, specifications, and bills of materials. Possess a bachelor's degree in a relevant domain (e.g., electrical/mechanical engineering, construction management, supply chain) or equivalent practical experience. Preferred qualifications 10+ years experience in construction sourcing, procurement, or supply chain management. 5+ years experience in data center, semiconductor, energy, or other large industrial construction programs. Experience working for or with electrical or mechanical contractors, general contractors, distributors, or prefabrication and modular integrators. Experience setting up owner-furnished or direct-purchase material programs across multiple sites. Familiarity with liquid cooling piping materials (stainless pipe, quick disconnects, manifolds, hoses) and medium-voltage terminations. Leadership and influencing skills. Deadline to apply: None. Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis. The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. Annual Salary: $320,000 — $405,000 USD Logistics Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices. Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this. For roles performing work in California: We will consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with arrest or conviction records or criminal histories, in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable state and local laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the City of Los Angeles’ Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act. We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team. Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings. How we're different We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills. The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences. Come work with us! Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

items.title: EDA Cloud & Developer Infrastructure Engineer
items.description: About the Team OpenAI’s Hardware organization develops AI-native silicon and system-level solutions for the unique demands of advanced AI workloads. Building on efforts like Jalapeño, our custom silicon program, the team works across silicon architecture, RTL design, verification, physical design, systems software, and infrastructure to deliver highly performant, efficient, and scalable hardware solutions. The Silicon & Systems team brings together hardware and software engineers to co-design and build the next generation of AI infrastructure. We operate at the intersection of silicon, systems, and software, tackling complex technical challenges across the full hardware development lifecycle, from early architecture and design through validation, deployment, and production. About the Role We’re looking for an Infrastructure Software Engineer to build and scale the infrastructure and developer workflows that power OpenAI’s custom silicon development. You’ll work closely with engineering teams across design verification, physical design, emulation, formal verification, and systems software to develop reliable, automated, and efficient workflows that accelerate hardware development. In this role, you'll own and improve the cloud infrastructure, high-performance computing (HPC) environments, CI/CD pipelines, regression systems, and data platforms that support our silicon engineering teams. You'll translate complex hardware development requirements into scalable infrastructure solutions, reducing manual overhead, improving reliability, and enabling engineers to iterate faster. This is a highly collaborative, hands-on role with opportunities to drive improvements across the entire hardware development lifecycle. We're looking for engineers who bring deep expertise in one or more infrastructure domains, strong software engineering fundamentals, and an interest in expanding their impact across the broader platform. In this role, you will: - Build developer tools and workflows: Partner with hardware engineering teams to understand their development processes, identify bottlenecks, and build tooling, services, and APIs that automate workflows and accelerate engineering productivity. - Develop and scale regression infrastructure: Design, implement, and operate large-scale regression systems spanning job scheduling, execution, results collection, triage, and reporting, with a focus on performance, reliability, and reproducibility. - Own CI/CD infrastructure: Build and maintain automated pipelines for infrastructure, developer tooling, and cluster configurations, enabling safe deployments, testing, and continuous improvement. - Scale cloud and HPC environments: Design, provision, and operate cloud infrastructure and high-performance compute clusters, optimizing scheduling, capacity, reliability, and cost efficiency to support demanding silicon development workloads. - Build data infrastructure and observability: Develop data pipelines, databases, and monitoring systems that provide visibility into regression results, infrastructure health, resource utilization, and engineering efficiency. - Drive platform reliability and operational excellence: Troubleshoot complex infrastructure issues, improve monitoring and alerting, automate recovery processes, and build systems that are resilient, maintainable, and scalable. - Collaborate across hardware and software teams: Work directly with engineers across RTL, verification, physical design, emulation, and software to continuously improve the infrastructure supporting OpenAI's silicon development. You might thrive in this role if you: - Have strong software engineering fundamentals, with proficiency in Python or a similar programming language and experience building reliable automation, tools, or infrastructure services. - Bring deep technical expertise in at least one area of infrastructure engineering, such as Linux/HPC environments, cloud infrastructure, CI/CD systems, storage, networking, or EDA development workflows. - Have experience designing, deploying, and operating cloud infrastructure, preferably Azure, with familiarity in infrastructure-as-code tools such as Terraform or Bicep. - Have strong Linux systems knowledge, including processes, filesystems, networking, permissions, performance troubleshooting, and system administration. - Have experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines using tools such as Jenkins, Buildkite, GitHub Actions, or similar platforms. - Are comfortable debugging complex distributed infrastructure problems, identifying root causes, and implementing durable solutions. - Enjoy working closely with engineering teams to understand technical requirements and translate them into scalable, practical infrastructure solutions. - Take ownership of systems end to end, from initial design and implementation through deployment, monitoring, and ongoing operational improvements. - Bring strong technical judgment, clear communication, and a collaborative approach to solving ambiguous engineering challenges. - Are curious about hardware development and excited to expand your technical expertise across infrastructure, silicon design workflows, and developer productivity. Bonus Qualifications - Experience supporting ASIC or semiconductor development environments, including EDA workflows, design verification, physical design, emulation, or formal verification. - Experience operating large-scale HPC clusters or workload schedulers such as Slurm. - Familiarity with compute farms, regression frameworks, build systems, and hardware development toolchains. - Experience with enterprise identity and authentication systems, such as Entra ID, OpenLDAP, FreeIPA, or SSSD. - Experience designing and operating relational databases such as PostgreSQL or MySQL, including schema design, migrations, query optimization, and backups. - Familiarity with distributed systems components, including message queues, caching layers, artifact storage, and backend services. - Experience with high-performance storage systems, data movement optimization, or large-scale compute infrastructure. - Experience managing EDA license servers, license utilization, or other shared infrastructure resources in hardware development environments. items.title: Director of Corporate Development
items.location_text: Menlo Park, CA; New York, NY
items.description: Join us in building the future of finance. Our mission is to democratize finance for all. An estimated $124 trillion of assets will be inherited by younger generations in the next two decades. The largest transfer of wealth in human history. If you’re ready to be at the epicenter of this historic cultural and financial shift, keep reading. About the team + role We are building an elite team, applying frontier technologies to the world’s biggest financial problems. We’re looking for bold thinkers. Sharp problem-solvers. Builders who are wired to make an impact. Robinhood isn’t a place for complacency, it’s where ambitious people do the best work of their careers. We’re a high-performing, fast-moving team with ethics at the center of everything we do. Expectations are high, and so are the rewards. Robinhood is looking for a Director of Corporate Development to help accelerate our roadmap by identifying, vetting, and executing acquisitions, strategic investments, and other transactions. In this role, you will develop a deep understanding of Robinhood's strategic priorities and market landscape, and partner with GMs and senior leadership to identify high-potential opportunities across our existing and future product verticals and geographies. You will help build Robinhood's network of founders, investors, and bankers, and develop relationships that may lead to acquisitions or strategic investments. You will work closely with deal sponsors and cross-functional leaders across Robinhood on all aspects of M&A, including business case construction, valuation analysis, deal structuring, negotiation, due diligence, execution, and post-close integration. You will present opportunities to company leadership and the Board of Directors, facilitate key decisions, and provide post-acquisition performance updates. The ideal candidate is strategic, relationship-oriented, analytical, and results-oriented, and thrives at a public company that still operates like a startup. This role is based in our Menlo Park, CA or New York, NY offices, with in-person attendance expected 3 days per week. At Robinhood, we believe in the power of in-person work to accelerate progress, spark innovation, and strengthen community. Our office experience is intentional, energizing, and designed to fully support high-performing teams. What you’ll do Analyze Robinhood's strategic landscape, gather competitive and industry intelligence, and develop the business case and rationale for key M&A opportunities, advocating for them internally. Manage transactions end to end, including sourcing, valuation, negotiation, diligence, and closing, and partner with integration teams to deliver a seamless post-close transition. Lead deal evaluation meetings and drive decision-making with objectivity, diplomacy, and effectiveness. Cultivate relationships with founders, venture capital firms, and investment banks to build a proactive pipeline of future acquisitions and strategic investments. Collaborate with business sponsors and leaders across Legal, Finance, Compliance, Product, and Engineering to build clear business and financial cases and execute deals. Present opportunities and recommendations to senior leadership and the Board of Directors, and report on post-acquisition performance against the original deal thesis. Help build scalable processes, playbooks, and best practices that shape the operating system of Robinhood's Corporate Development team. What you bring 10+ years of experience in corporate development, investment banking, venture capital, private equity, or other investing roles, ideally within fintech, financial services, or consumer technology. Track record of sourcing, leading, and closing complex technology acquisitions or strategic investments, ideally including in-house corporate development experience. Exceptional analytical skills, including company valuation, financial modeling, and structured problem solving. Ability to reason from first principles, using data and analysis to draw sound conclusions, with a bias toward action: analyze fast, decide, and either move forward or move on. Strong interpersonal skills and a track record of building strong working relationships with founders, investors, bankers, and executives. Executive presence and outstanding written and verbal communication, including experience presenting to senior leadership and boards. Resourceful, persistent, and able to thrive in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment. Familiarity with Robinhood and our industry. You enjoy managing your money on your phone! What we offer Challenging, high-impact work to grow your career. Performance-driven compensation with multipliers for outsized impact, bonus programs, equity ownership, and 401(k) matching. Best-in-class benefits to fuel your work, including 100% paid health insurance for employees with 90% coverage for dependents. Lifestyle wallet — a highly flexible benefits spending account for wellness, learning, and more. Employer-paid life & disability insurance, fertility benefits, and mental health benefits. Time off to recharge including company holidays, paid time off, sick time, parental leave, and more! Exceptional office experience with catered meals, events, and comfortable workspaces. In addition to the base pay range listed below, this role is also eligible for bonus opportunities + equity + benefits. Base pay for the successful applicant will depend on a variety of job-related factors, which may include education, training, experience, location, business needs, or market demands. The expected base pay range for this role is based on the location where the work will be performed and is aligned to one of 3 compensation zones. For other locations not listed, compensation can be discussed with your recruiter during the interview process. Base Pay Range: Zone 1 (Menlo Park, CA; New York, NY; Bellevue, WA; Washington, DC) $242,000 — $285,000 USD Zone 2 (Denver, CO; Westlake, TX; Chicago, IL) $213,000 — $251,000 USD Zone 3 (Lake Mary, FL; Clearwater, FL; Gainesville, FL) $189,000 — $222,000 USD Click here to learn more about our Total Rewards, which vary by region and entity. If our mission energizes you and you’re ready to build the future of finance, we look forward to seeing your application. AI Usage Disclosure: Robinhood uses artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of our recruiting process. These tools enhance the efficiency and consistency of our hiring process; however, all hiring decisions are made by our hiring teams. Robinhood provides equal opportunity for all applicants, offers reasonable accommodations upon request, and complies with applicable equal employment and privacy laws. Inclusion is built into how we hire and work—welcoming different backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences so everyone can do their best. Please review the Privacy Policy for your country of application.

items.title: Identity & Access Management Lead
items.description: WE ARE BETCLIC 🎯 Betclic, European leader in sports betting, is much more than just an online gaming site! Also offering Poker, Horse Racing, and Casino games across various countries and continents, it is an inspiring and forward-thinking company: every day brings new challenges in a modern and dynamic environment. As an influential player in the tech industry, with strong and sustained growth over the years, we believe in innovation through diversity and inclusion and encourage everyone to reach their full potential. With our multicultural team, we provide an optimal, safe and responsible gaming experience, powered by cutting-edge technology. WHY JOIN US? 🚀 At Betclic, success comes from passionate and committed teams. Here’s why you’ll love working with us: 💡An international and creative environment where every project is an opportunity to innovate 📈Hypergrowth that brings new challenges and development opportunities every day 🏡A healthy work-life balance: flexible remote work and workplace well-being are essential pillars for us. 🌟A unique and friendly atmosphere, with 1,600 employees across 5 countries and our headquarters in Bordeaux Are you passionate about sports and tech? Join us and help shape the future of online gaming! ENTER THE GAME🎮 As a member of the SecOps team within Defensive Security, you will build and lead a cross-functional Identity and Access Management (IAM) capability from the ground up. You will define the vision, establish the foundations and coordinate the teams and processes needed to manage identities and access across multiple environments and tenants, including Active Directory, Entra ID and Okta. YOUR ROLE WITHIN BETCLIC🔥 In this role, your main missions will be to: Strategy, organization, governance · Assess the existing IAM landscape , including directories, applications, identity data, access models, provisioning workflows and integrations; identify technical gaps, risks and implementation dependencies. · Define the IAM strategy, governance framework, target architecture and roadmap , translating requirements into technical designs and implementation plans (covering configuration, integrations, data and entitlement mapping, migration, testing and deployment) · Partner with IT, business and security teams to define access requirements and controls for workforce, privileged and service accounts. · Establish identity lifecycle processes with HR and IT, covering joiners, movers, leavers and role changes; · Design and implement an Identity Governance and Administration (IGA) framework, including role and entitlement models, access reviews, ownership and segregation of duties. · Promote IAM best practices and clarify access management responsibilities across the organisation. Architecture and technical solutions · Lead the end-to-end implementation of IAM and IGA solution, workflows and controls , from design and integration through deployment and operational handover, including access requests, approvals, provisioning, access changes, reviews and deprovisioning. · Define the access control model, including RBAC and ABAC approaches, entitlement mapping, access bundles, and rules for exceptional or time-bound access. · Design and oversee lifecycle automation across applications and directories · Lead the integration and evolution of IAM solutions across environments such as Active Directory, Microsoft Entra ID and Okta. · Evaluate external IGA and IAM solutions. · Define multi-tenant standards and IAM governance, including operating processes, application and role ownership, and control monitoring. · Establish performance indicators and drive continuous improvement. WHO ARE WE LOOKING FOR? 🔍 We are looking for passionate and curious professionals who bring kindness and a touch of enthusiasm! You have at least 5 years of experience in IAM or cybersecurity, including significant experience leading cross-functional projects or programmes. You have built or significantly improved an IAM or IGA capability in a complex, multi-entity or multi-tenant environment. You have experience with identity platforms and directories such as Active Directory, Microsoft Entra ID and/or Okta. You understand identity lifecycle management, access governance, role and entitlement models, access certification and segregation of duties. You have practical knowledge of identity integration and provisioning standards, including SCIM 2.0, SAML 2.0, OpenID Connect (OIDC) and OAuth 2.0. You understand authentication and access control concepts, including single sign-on (SSO), multi-factor authentication (MFA), privileged access management (PAM) and service or non-human identities. You can work effectively with HR, IT, business and security teams, translating business processes into secure and practical identity controls. You have strong analytical, organisational and communication skills, and can prioritise work across a broad stakeholder landscape. You are proactive, adaptable and comfortable building a new capability in an evolving technical and business context. You have excellent communication skills, both written and verbal. And finally, you speak English fluently WHAT ARE THE RECRUITMENT STEPS?📝 If your application is shortlisted, Maxime will contact you within a week for an initial HR screening (30 minutes). Then, you will complete the AssessFirst test (personality, motivation and cognitive reasoning). Next, you will have a technical interview with Jean-Luc, Senior Defensive Cybersecurity Manager, and a technical expert. You will then meet with Sophie, Global Security Director. Finally, Maxime will conduct a final HR interview to review your AssessFirst results together. The recruitment process usually takes between 4 to 6 weeks to ensure an optimal experience for you. WHAT CAN YOU EXPECT?🎁 ✅ 25 days of paid leave and 10 RTT days 🍽️ A Ticket Restaurant® card credited with €11 per day (€6 per day funded by Betclic) 🩺 100% health insurance coverage for you and your children 🚆 50% reimbursement of public transport costs or an annual sustainable mobility allowance (€230 for commuting with sustainable transport) 🏡 Hybrid work model 📚 Access to a vast training catalog, with opportunities for professional development every year 🏢 Extraordinary office spaces with a rooftop where you can enjoy sunny breaks with a view of the Cité du Vin 🎉 Internal events to liven up your daily life 🏋️ On-site sports classes and organized tournaments (Pilates, circuit training, boxing, yoga, futsal, padel, tennis…) Permanent contract, available immediately in Bordeaux (remote from another city possible depending on profile - on-site presence required twice a month)Betclic Group – 117 Quai de Bacalan, 33300 BORDEAUX

items.title: CRM / Data Platform Consultant
items.description: Part-Time | Project-Based 🚀 ABOUT OUR CLIENT Our client is developing a next-generation MarTech platform designed to help businesses unlock new revenue opportunities and scale through smarter technology. As part of its product expansion, the team is developing an advanced iGaming player data platform and looking for an experienced industry professional to help shape its strategy, architecture, and roadmap. 🎯 ABOUT THE ROLE This is an opportunity to put your iGaming CRM / CDP expertise into practice and directly influence the development of a new player data platform. Our client is looking for an experienced consultant who understands how leading iGaming operators manage player data, retention, segmentation, promotions, and multi-brand ecosystems. You'll help evaluate the market, identify the right technology solutions, and define what should be built in-house versus sourced from third-party providers. 💡 WHAT YOU'LL BE WORKING ON - Industry & Market Research: Analyze existing iGaming CRM, CDP, and PAM solutions, identify leading providers, compare capabilities, and share industry best practices. - Product Strategy: Help define the vision and priorities for a unified player data platform across multiple brands. - Build vs. Buy Assessment: Evaluate third-party solutions, their features, pricing, and suitability versus developing an in-house platform. - Roadmap Development: Define key functionalities, technical requirements, resources, priorities, and implementation timelines. - Expert Advisory: Challenge existing product ideas, review proposed solutions, and provide practical recommendations based on your hands-on experience. - Performance & Retention: Advise on player segmentation, real-time triggers, bonus effectiveness, and measuring incremental revenue. 🔍 WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR - Hands-on experience with iGaming CRM, Customer Data Platforms (CDP), or Player Account Management (PAM) systems. - Strong understanding of player lifecycle management, retention, player profiles, and segmentation. - Experience with multi-brand or cross-brand player data environments. - Background in designing or implementing player profiles, bonus targeting, promotional mechanics, game recommendations, or real-time triggers. - Understanding of player wallets, bonus engines, reward mechanics, and promotional rules. - Ability to assess CRM and bonus performance through data, experiments, and incremental revenue measurement. - Knowledge of bonus abuse prevention and responsible gambling principles. - Strong analytical and strategic thinking, with the ability to turn complex industry knowledge into clear recommendations and actionable roadmaps. - Excellent written and verbal English communication skills. ⭐ NICE TO HAVE - Experience working directly with iGaming operators. - Experience building or selecting in-house CRM / CDP solutions. - Familiarity with unified wallets, bonus engines, missions, tournaments, and reward systems. - Experience with white-label or multi-market platforms, particularly in Asia or Latin America. - Knowledge of analytics platforms such as Amplitude, Mixpanel, or PostHog. - Experience designing control-group experiments and measuring campaign effectiveness. What makes this opportunity interesting? You won't be stepping into another operational CRM role. Instead, you'll have the chance to share your expertise, influence product direction, and help shape a platform from the ground up — while maintaining flexibility over your workload.

items.title: Marketing Lead, Claude Frontier Academy
items.location_text: San Francisco, CA | New York City, NY
items.description: About Anthropic Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. About the role Claude Frontier Academy is where organizations nominate their strongest people to build deep, hands-on skills with Claude. Backed by a $100 million commitment, Anthropic aims to train 10,000 Frontier Deployed Engineers by the end of 2027. The Academy’s first program, the Frontier Deployed Engineer (FDE) Residency, brings engineers from leading customers and partners together in cohorts, and more programs will follow. We’re looking for a Marketing Lead to make the Academy a name the market knows and a credential people are proud to earn. As the Academy’s first dedicated marketer, you’ll own how it shows up in the world. You’re a creative, versatile marketer who thinks in terms of brand and communications and also knows how to position, launch, and grow programs. You’ll turn each program launch into a major market moment, celebrate milestones like new cohorts and the first badges earned, and build a community of graduates who help tell the story. Because the Academy serves both partners and customers, this role will sit on our Partner Marketing team. You’ll work directly with partners and customers to secure their participation in announcements and bring them into our launch and amplification plans. You’ll help shape the Academy’s strategy and annual plan and represent marketing with senior leaders, while staying hands-on enough to write the first draft yourself. Partners and customers already engage with other Anthropic education and training programs, so you’ll be thoughtful about how the Academy fits alongside them. If you’ve built a branded program at a B2B technology company and want to do it again at a much bigger scale, this role is for you. Key responsibilities Own the marketing strategy and annual plan for Claude Frontier Academy and its programs, working with Academy leadership to set priorities and goals Build and maintain a calendar of market moments for the Academy and each program, including program launches, new cohorts, and badge milestones Lead launches end to end, from messaging and announcement drafts through legal and executive review, launch-day execution and post-launch amplification Partner with Communications on press releases and announcements, including sourcing customer and partner quotes and securing approval to use their names Align early with Partnerships, Communications, and Account Teams on which customers and partners are named in each announcement, who gets a heads-up before it goes live, and how to answer those who aren’t named Develop amplification plans with partners and customers across social posts, blogs, newsletters, and their own announcements, and turn cohort results into joint customer and partner stories Grow the Academy’s presence on LinkedIn and other social channels with content that showcases programs, cohorts, and graduates Own the Academy’s web presence and any paid promotion, working with our web team and with creative and agency partners Build a community program that keeps cohort members and badge holders connected and turns them into advocates for the Academy Work with Brand to extend the Academy’s naming and brand architecture as new programs launch, keeping it consistent with, and clearly distinct from, Anthropic’s other education and training offerings Learn Anthropic’s other education and training programs, such as Claude Academy, Claude certifications, and Partner Basecamp, and work with their teams to define where Claude Frontier Academy fits, where the programs connect, and how they reference each other, so partners and customers see one clear path Equip Account Teams and Partner Account Managers with FAQs, internal announcements, and guidance so they can answer questions, help customers and partners register their interest, and set clear expectations on participation Keep senior stakeholders aligned through regular status updates and clear recommendations, and define and report on success metrics for Academy marketing Minimum qualifications Have built and run branded B2B marketing programs at a software/SaaS technology company, such as customer education, certification, community, or user conference programs Have marketed education, training, or certification programs at a technology company, such as a partner, customer, or developer academy Bring a creative, brand-minded approach and know how to create market moments that get noticed Have led major launches or announcements, coordinating press, social, and partner amplification, and keeping everyone aligned through legal review, executive edits, and date changes Know how to build an audience and spark conversation on LinkedIn and other social channels with B2B audiences Have strong executive presence and are comfortable giving updates and making recommendations to senior leaders Can operate at both strategic and tactical levels, comfortable owning an annual plan and rolling up your sleeves to ship Build trusted relationships with partners, customers, and cross-functional teams, and can drive approvals and commitments without formal authority Are an excellent writer who can move easily between press releases, FAQs, and social posts Are energized by ambiguity and by building something new as a first-in-seat marketer Passionate about AI diffusion and bringing the benefits of AI to people and the world Preferred qualifications 8+ years of B2B software marketing experience spanning brand, communications, or program marketing Experience building community or advocacy programs where members promote the program themselves Experience marketing to technical audiences, particularly engineers and developers Experience running joint announcements with global system integrators, consulting firms, or enterprise customers Experience marketing to enterprise technology leaders, such as CIOs and CTOs Experience marketing AI/ML products Role-specific policy: For this role, we expect all staff to be able to work from our San Francisco office at least 2 days a week, though we encourage you to apply even if you might need some flexibility for an interim period of time for relocation. Deadline to apply: None. Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis. The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. Annual Salary: $320,000 — $320,000 USD Logistics Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices. Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this. For roles performing work in California: We will consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with arrest or conviction records or criminal histories, in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable state and local laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the City of Los Angeles’ Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act. We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team. Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings. How we're different We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. items.title: Senior AI Operations Engineer, Enterprise Tech
items.location_text: Bellevue, WA; Menlo Park, CA; New York, NY
items.description: Join us in building the future of finance. Our mission is to democratize finance for all. An estimated $124 trillion of assets will be inherited by younger generations in the next two decades. The largest transfer of wealth in human history. If you’re ready to be at the epicenter of this historic cultural and financial shift, keep reading. About the team + role We are building an elite team, applying frontier technologies to the world’s biggest financial problems. We’re looking for bold thinkers. Sharp problem-solvers. Builders who are wired to make an impact. Robinhood isn’t a place for complacency, it’s where ambitious people do the best work of their careers. We’re a high-performing, fast-moving team with ethics at the center of everything we do. Expectations are high, and so are the rewards. The Corporate Engineering team is building and scaling the next generation of enterprise AI infrastructure at Robinhood. Our mission is to make AI capabilities reliable, secure, and accessible across the company, enabling teams to build, deploy, and operate intelligent solutions at scale. From enterprise LLM integrations to agentic workflows and hybrid cloud infrastructure, we're creating the foundation that supports how Robinhood leverages AI internally. As a Senior AI Operations Engineer, Enterprise Tech, you'll play a key role in building, operating, and improving the infrastructure behind Robinhood's enterprise AI capabilities. You'll work across AI platforms, LLM integrations, automation, and production infrastructure, serving as a technical expert for complex challenges while partnering directly with developers and internal teams. This is an opportunity to help shape a growing function, solve emerging problems in AI operations, and build the systems and tooling that enable AI adoption across Robinhood. This role is based in our Menlo Park, CA, New York, NY, and Bellevue, WA offices, with in-person attendance expected at least 3 days per week. At Robinhood, we believe in the power of in-person work to accelerate progress, spark innovation, and strengthen community. Our office experience is intentional, energizing, and designed to fully support high-performing teams. What you’ll do Build internal tooling, automation, and self-service solutions that streamline AI operations, reduce manual intervention, and improve the developer experience. Own complex technical troubleshooting and escalations across AI platforms, working directly with developers and internal teams to resolve issues involving LLM integrations, model behavior, APIs, and system performance. Manage and optimize enterprise integrations with LLM providers, including Anthropic Claude and Google Gemini, focusing on performance, token utilization, reliability, and cost efficiency. Develop and improve observability, monitoring, and deployment pipelines for AI workloads, tracking metrics such as inference latency, API costs, token usage, and error rates. Support and optimize agentic workflows, orchestration layers, vector databases, and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems to improve reliability and scalability. Partner with Product, Software Engineering, Business Systems, and AI Strategy teams to identify recurring issues, incorporate user feedback, and drive long-term improvements to enterprise AI capabilities. What you bring 5+ years of experience in IT Operations, Site Reliability Engineering, or AI infrastructure and support, with a track record of operating complex production systems. Hands-on experience with enterprise AI platforms and LLM integrations, particularly Anthropic Claude and Google Gemini, including API integrations, prompt operations, and token management. Strong Linux administration skills and proficiency in scripting and automation using Python, Bash, or similar languages. Experience with infrastructure provisioning, configuration management, and orchestration tools such as Terraform, Ansible, Chef, or Kubernetes. Strong understanding of production infrastructure, system reliability, monitoring, and troubleshooting across cloud or on-premises environments. Ability to independently investigate ambiguous technical problems, identify root causes, and develop scalable solutions that prevent recurring issues. Strong communication and collaboration skills, with experience partnering directly with developers and cross-functional teams to resolve technical challenges. Bonus: Experience with GPU clusters, AI workload orchestration (Slurm, Ray), vector databases (Pinecone, Milvus), AI frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex), or hybrid cloud and bare-metal infrastructure. What we offer Challenging, high-impact work to grow your career. Performance driven compensation with multipliers for outsized impact, bonus programs, equity ownership, and 401(k) matching. Top Tier benefits to fuel your work, including 100% paid health insurance for employees with 90% coverage for dependents. Access to the Robinhood Employee Fund that gives eligible US employees the opportunity to invest in a private employee fund that provides exposure to Robinhood Ventures funds. Access to the best AI tools on the market and continuous AI skill-building for every employee, technical or not. Lifestyle wallet - a highly flexible benefits spending account for wellness, learning, and more. Employer-paid life & disability insurance, fertility benefits, and mental health benefits. Time off to recharge including company holidays, paid time off, sick time, parental leave, and more! Exceptional office experience with catered meals, events, and comfortable workspaces. In addition to the base pay range listed below, this role is also eligible for bonus opportunities + equity + benefits. items.description: About the Team The Growth team drives user and revenue growth across ChatGPT’s consumer and business segments worldwide. We work across the full funnel, from acquisition and activation to retention and monetization, through product experiments, in-product improvements, performance marketing, creative development, and AI-powered workflows. The International Growth team works with regional leaders in priority markets to identify the user needs and product gaps that matter most for adoption, usage, and monetization. We turn market priorities into product roadmaps and growth plans, then partner with engineering, research, design, data science, marketing, finance, policy, and partnerships to test and ship improvements. We combine product strategy with hands-on growth operations. We account for local behavior, competition, and product experience while building shared capabilities such as segmentation, lifecycle journeys, and experimentation systems. We measure what ships, adapt it to the market, and scale approaches that work across markets. About the Role We’re looking for a growth lead for Brazil to shape and execute ChatGPT’s growth plans. You’ll partner with regional and market leaders to understand users across Brazil, prioritize the biggest growth opportunities across markets, and turn those priorities into product improvements, funnel optimizations, and performance marketing tests. You’ll work across acquisition, activation, retention, and monetization, collaborating with Product, Engineering, Design, Data Science, Partnerships, and Marketing teams to influence priorities and ship measurable impact. The role combines product growth and funnel optimization with performance marketing: connecting audience, message, creative, and channel learnings to better in-product journeys. In this role, you will: - Partner with regional and market leaders to set a Brazil growth plan and market-level roadmap priorities, with clear hypotheses, owners, dependencies, and measurable outcomes. - Use user research, funnel and cohort data, and competitive insight to find local friction and prioritize the opportunities that matter most to users. - Run performance marketing tests in collaboration with regional marketers across relevant channels, creators, and partners; use incrementally, CAC, payback, and LTV to decide what to scale. - Design and run rigorous experiments across onboarding, activation, repeat usage, re-engagement, and paid conversion; measure incremental impact and iterate. Work with Product, Engineering, Design, and Data Science partners to prototype, test, and ship locally relevant experiences. - Partner with regional Marketing and central media teams to brief and prioritize audience, positioning, creative, and channel tests based on the regional plan and market priorities. - Own the regional growth scorecard with market-level views across acquisition, retention, paid conversion, and unit economics, distinguishing incremental user and revenue gains and learnings. Connect priority use cases, product improvements, and acquisition plans into a coherent journey from first exposure to repeated value. - Run the growth operating cadence with regional and market leaders, aligning central and local partners on results, trade-offs, dependencies, and next steps. - Build and operate segmentation, lifecycle journeys, growth tooling, performance marketing and product experimentation capabilities that can be scaled across markets. You might thrive if you have: - 10+ years of experience across product growth, growth marketing, data science, or growth strategy and operations, with hands-on execution in a fast-moving technology company. - A user-first track record of turning local research and behavior into product and growth priorities, then shipping improvements with measurable impact. - Strong command of acquisition, activation, retention, and monetization funnels, including technically rigorous experimentation and interpretation. - Practical performance marketing experience across audience, channel, creative, and measurement decisions, and the ability to partner effectively with media specialists. - Analytical fluency in cohort analysis and growth economics, including incrementality, LTV, CAC, payback, and contribution margin. - Experience adapting and running campaigns across Latin American markets, using local audience behavior, channels, language, and cultural context to improve relevance and performance at scale. - Experience owning growth goals and delivering measurable user or revenue outcomes across product and marketing levers. - The ability to influence and align central and regional teams, translate local needs into scalable approaches, and make progress through ambiguity. items.title: Senior Security Operations Engineer
items.description: WHO ARE WE? Cohere is the leading security-first enterprise AI company. We build cutting-edge foundation AI models and end-to-end products that are designed to solve real-world business problems. We’re training and deploying frontier models for enterprises who are building AI systems. We believe that our work is instrumental to the widespread adoption of AI and we are looking for folks that want to be part of that. We obsess over what we build. Each one of us is responsible for contributing to increasing the capabilities of our models and the value they drive for our customers. Cohere is a team of researchers, engineers, designers, and more, who are all passionate about their craft. We are a global technology company headquartered in Toronto with key offices in London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul. Join us! As a Senior Security Operations Engineer you will: - Serve as trusted advisor to team’s leadership and partner teams by clearly articulating business risks associated with security issues - Harden our cloud-native environments (AWS, OCI, GCP) by introducing secure by default cloud controls - Own and drive resolutions for enabling engineers to design, build, and use infrastructure securely at scale by paving the secure path using infrastructure-as-code modules and reusable code libraries - Manage IAM / RBAC for cloud infrastructure, and partner with IT on streamlining authentication/authorization to ensure unified access control across the board - Deploy, integrate and operationalize security platforms and services including but not limited to SIEM, SOAR, domain monitoring, endpoint tooling, cloud security tooling - Respond to security incidents and harden environments post-incidents. - Support control monitoring and remediation for compliance initiatives - Gather and analyze security metrics to address security issues with cross-team dependencies - Partner empathetically with engineering teams to understand their needs and deliver practical, scalable security solutions without creating unnecessary friction. You may be a good fit if: - 5+ years previous experience in SecOps, DevSecOps, Cloud Security, Threat Detection & Response or software development with a strong focus on security engineering. - You’re a hands-on security engineer interested in automating controls and building scalable solutions rather than relying on manual processes. - You have experience in managing cloud platforms (GCP, AWS, Azure, OCI) and Kubernetes environments - Familiarity with CI/CD systems and SecOps workflows (Git, Terraform) in cloud environments (GCP, AWS, Azure, OCI) - Have practical experience with one or more of : infrastructure automation, network segmentation, system hardening, container and cloud security concepts, and security observability - You have experience with multiple languages such as Golang and/or Python - Are comfortable navigating ambiguity, making informed decisions with incomplete information, and adapting your approach as requirements evolve. - You employ a flexible and constructive approach when solving problems - You are able to make trade-offs between build vs. buy decisions - help build solutions and able to review what tools are available - You understand secure engineering best practices, can articulate problem statements and propose solutions to both technically savvy and non-technical audiences FULL-TIME EMPLOYEES AT COHERE ENJOY THESE PERKS: - A weekly lunch stipend of $75/£75 or equivalent in your local currency for lunch. - Full health and dental benefits, including a separate budget for mental health. - RRSP matching, 401K, Pension Scheme. - 100% Parental Leave top-up for up to 6 months, for either parent. - Annual enrichment benefits: Arts & culture, fitness/wellness, quality time, and a workspace improvement credit. Education & learning stipend for conferences, courses, and coaching. - 6 weeks of paid vacation (30 working days!) - Budget for traveling to other offices if you are remote, plus an annual company offsite. HOW AND WHERE WE WORK: - Cohere is remote-friendly, but we also have offices in Toronto, London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul with more opening soon. - For those in the office: a daily lunch program, plenty of snacks, and regular community and social events. - For those not near an office: a co-working benefit so you can work alongside others in your city. - Everyone receives a $500 home office stipend to set up your workspace properly. This helps our recruiters identify potentially qualified candidates, but it doesn't limit the applications our recruiters may review or consider. Beware of Scams: Cohere will never ask for payment or third-party services (e.g., CV writing) as part of our hiring process. All legitimate roles are listed on the Cohere careers page and LinkedIn only, with all communications from Cohere employees coming from an @cohere.com or @cw.cohere email alias. If jobs are viewed on other sites then please verify these through our official careers https://cohere.com/careers page.
